en.headline: Driver arrested after FEHD contractor truck hits pedestrian in North Point
en.dek: A 45-year-old man was detained on suspicion of dangerous driving causing serious injury after his medium goods vehicle struck a 60-year-old woman on King's Road late Wednesday.
body: Police arrested a 45-year-old man on suspicion of dangerous driving causing serious injury after a medium goods vehicle operated by a Food and Environmental Hygiene Department contractor struck a pedestrian in North Point on Wednesday night.

The incident occurred at about 10pm when the truck, travelling east along King's Road, turned into Shu Kuk Street opposite the former Sunbeam Theatre and hit a 60-year-old woman surnamed Ng who was crossing the road. She was found unconscious and taken to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital for treatment. Sources said she had no visible surface injuries and was not in a life-threatening condition after receiving care.

The driver, surnamed Lam, passed a breathalyser test and was detained for investigation. The vehicle, which carried two other workers, was later towed from the scene. Police continue to examine the circumstances of the collision.

zh.headline: 北角食環署外判貨車撞途人 45歲司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 一名45歲男子涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕，其駕駛的中型貨車周三深夜在英皇道撞倒一名60歲女途人。
body: 警方拘捕一名45歲男子，涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害。事件涉及一輚食物環境衞生署外判承辦商的中型貨車，周三晚在北角撞倒一名女途人。
意外約於晚上10時發生。貨車沿英皇道東行，駛至前新光戲院對開轉入書局街時，撞到正在過路的60歲吳姓女子。女傷者昏迷，送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院救治。消息稱她身上未見明顯外傷，經治理後情況穩定，沒有生命危險。
涉事司機姓林，通過酒精呼氣測試，現正被扣留調查。車內當時另有兩名工人，貨車其後被拖走。警方繼續調查意外原因。
